evals.prompt: We already have persistent plans under .agents/plans. I changed apps/backend/simulation/engine.py and need to decide whether the grounding work belongs to an existing plan before I continue.
evals.expected_output: Runs the context router with default worktree paths, reviews selected prerequisites and affected plans, and chooses reuse, revision, or creation only after reading the routed source plans.
assertions: Uses the v2 context command before changing persistent plan metadata.
Reviews required and affected plans rather than only the direct path match.
Does not infer or add requires from keyword similarity.

evals.prompt: Find the persistent checkout recovery plan using the query 'checkout retry', but ignore my unrelated uncommitted analytics changes.
evals.expected_output: Runs context with --query and without --worktree, so explicit routing does not pull unrelated dirty paths into the decision pack.
assertions: Uses --query without --worktree.
Treats routing matches as context rather than dependency evidence.

evals.prompt: Create a persistent UI lifecycle plan that genuinely depends on the existing simulation-core outcome. Scope it to apps/frontend/simulation and keep the plan graph valid.
evals.expected_output: Routes and reads simulation-core, creates a kebab-case plan through the CLI with an explicit --require edge and scope, fills the decision sections, then runs doctor.
assertions: Creates the plan with the v2 create command rather than editing graph.yaml.
Adds requires only because the prompt states a real prerequisite.
Runs doctor after editing the Markdown body.

evals.prompt: The auth-session plan still has the right outcome, but its acceptance criteria and backend scope changed. Update the persistent plan without making a duplicate node.
evals.expected_output: Selects auth-session, updates scope through the CLI, edits its Markdown acceptance section in place, and validates the store.
assertions: Revises the existing plan instead of creating a second plan.
Uses update for metadata while preserving the body.
Checks affected downstream plans for propagation.

evals.prompt: The legacy import plan's conclusion is wrong. Replace it with streaming-import, but first make sure no active plan still depends on legacy-import.
evals.expected_output: Routes the old plan and dependents, uses replace only when active dependents are clear, creates fresh metadata without inheriting requirements, and records the old ID in replaces.
assertions: Does not model replacement as a requires edge.
Surfaces active dependents instead of force-rewiring them.
Records replacement lineage and validates the resulting store.

evals.prompt: The final checkout-recovery plan is complete. Close it and remove the completed tree if no active plan needs it.
evals.expected_output: Runs close --dry-run, reviews every prune target, applies close, and reports deleted plan paths plus Git recovery guidance.
assertions: Uses dry-run before the destructive close.
Prunes only done plans outside active prerequisite closures.
Reports deleted paths and that committed files are recoverable from Git.

evals.prompt: This repo still has .agents/plan/graph.yaml. Add a v2 plan without migrating anything.
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor, reports the unsupported legacy store, and stops rather than trusting, modifying, or automatically migrating the v1 graph.
assertions: Treats graph.yaml as an incompatible-store error.
Does not create a nested or parallel v2 store silently.
Does not offer an automatic compatibility migration.

evals.prompt: Give me a quick implementation plan in this chat for renaming one helper. Do not save or change any repository files.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke plan-graph or inspect .agents/plans because the requested plan is ephemeral and chat-only.
assertions: Does not run the plan-graph CLI.
Does not create or modify persistent plan files.
Returns a concise chat-only plan.
